    def ik(self, targets: dict, seed=None, base_pose=None, **opts) -> dict:
        """Inverse kinematics: {frame: [x,y,z, quat]} (frames from spec()['kinematics']['ik_targets']) and an optional seed q ->
        {"ok", "q", "error": {frame: {"pos_m", "rot_rad"}}}. opts: tol_pos_m, tol_rot_rad, max_iters."""
        body = {"op": "ik", "targets": {k: [float(v) for v in p] for k, p in targets.items()}, **opts}
        if seed is not None: body["seed"] = [float(v) for v in np.asarray(seed).reshape(-1)]

"""Mustard to robot-left bin, eai-standard/2.2.
Run with: PYTHONPATH=/opt/tools python /app/output/gen.py <stage>
Stages are deliberately separate so each camera observation can inform the next move.
"""
import sys, json, numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

Q_DOWN = [0.0, -0.7071068, 0.7071068, 0.0]
def pose(x,y,z,grip): return [x,y,z,*Q_DOWN,grip]

def main():
    stage = sys.argv[1]
    r=Robot()
    if stage == 'above':
        res=r.submit('ee_pose', [pose(.600,0,.310,0)], video='frames', depth=True, note='Move above mustard')
    elif stage == 'grasp':
        res=r.submit('ee_pose', [pose(.600,0,.125,0),pose(.600,0,.125,1)], video='frames', depth=True, note='Lower and grasp mustard')
    elif stage == 'lift':
        res=r.submit('ee_pose', [pose(.600,0,.340,1)], video='frames', depth=True, note='Lift mustard clear of table')
    elif stage == 'transfer':
        res=r.submit('ee_pose', [pose(.480,.300,.340,1)], video='frames', depth=True, note='Carry mustard over left bin')
    elif stage == 'drop':
        res=r.submit('ee_pose', [pose(.480,.300,.260,1),pose(.480,.300,.260,0)], video='frames', depth=True, note='Release mustard into left bin')
    elif stage == 'retract':
        res=r.submit('ee_pose', [pose(.480,.300,.350,0)], video='frames', depth=True, note='Retract after release')
    else: raise ValueError(stage)
    out=f'/app/runs/{stage}'
    res.save(out)
    print(json.dumps({'stage':stage,'meta':res.meta,'status':r.status()},indent=2))
if __name__ == '__main__':main()
PY
